selected_policy.entry_context: calls require higher lows across the last three completed bars; puts require lower highs
selected_policy.same_direction_breakout_rearm: price must close back through the prior broken level
selected_policy.reserved_slot: do not open SPY Trend from 13:45 through 15:00 ET while SPY Afternoon FVG is enabled
selected_policy.entry_price_ceiling: do not pay above the analyzed Tradier ask
